s00-cup: A black titanium chalice with a thin gold lip turns in darkness like a luxury product reveal, in a wet industrial data hall with vertical purple-green light tubes. Microscopic scanlines crawl over the cup like forensic inspection. Its reflections show server racks, LED grids and ghostly synthetic faces on surrounding screens. A tiny green contamination pulses under the rim, almost invisible. Text: POISONED CUPS assembles from broken scanlines and unstable signal fragments, then holds; MATTHEW 23 appears as a system classification tag.
Sets the film as a high-end indictment: polished surface, poisoned system.
s01-poison: Extreme close-up of the chalice being precision-polished by a laser-cleaning sweep; the camera rises over the rim into toxic luminous green fluid swirling with microchips, cable scrap, ash and oily residue. Text: YOU POLISH CUPS sleek and pristine along the outer contour; LEAVE THE POISON IN blooms from the liquid; "poison" target-locked in acid green.
Green glow narrowing to a point of light.
s02-fringes: Hanging fibre-optic tassel bundles and braided ID lanyards in a corporate-lit passage, swaying under fluorescent strips, glowing tips failing one by one; the LED signage behind is broken and empty. Text: LONG FRINGES SWING hangs vertically like product tags or credential strips; HEARTS STAY THIN as a shrinking waveform, a narrowing signal trace.
Public display of status as performative institutional optics.
A failing light becomes a green seam.
s03-tomb: A seamless white server monolith, spotless in a clean corridor; a thin green crack opens and the camera drives through into a dense corrupted cavity: black blades, fibre trunks, cable trays, blinking LEDs, coolant lines, pulsing decay. Text: WHITE STONE WALLS clean, sterile, architectural; OVER ROTTING BONES builds from flickering machine labels over the internals.
The tomb metaphor as institutional tech rot.
Decay pulses turn to a waveform.
s04-prayers: A soft voice-assistant waveform floats in darkness; on "cut" it extrudes into razor-thin obsidian shards and glassy vector slivers that slash across frame. Text: SOFT-SPOKE PRAYERS smooth and low-amplitude; CUT a hard signal spike; SHARPENED shears into fragments; "stones" implied by jagged geometry, not rocks.
Shards fly into a server aisle.
s05-vipers: A dark server aisle; thick black braided cables coil like sleeping serpents between racks, small green current pulses travelling along their spines; alarm heat shimmer at the far end; a wall of low flame reflection grows on the polished floor. Text: BROOD OF VIPERS towers vertically in segmented, snake-like type; "fire?" flares unstable orange-white, heat-distorted.
Introduces the tech-viper identity; the warning is quiet the first time.
s06-empire: A glowing fibre strand twists into a helix; zoom out: a skyline of stacked server towers, control stacks, trading terminals and policy dashboards, wrapped in graph lines and map overlays like propaganda skins. Text: TWIST THE TRUTH coils and misregisters; BUILD YOUR LITTLE EMPIRE stacks in blocks like rack units.
The skyline of towers matches the memorial screen wall.
s07-prophets: A memorial feed wall of giant LED screens with sanitised heroic faces ringed in UI laurels and tribute graphics; signal corruption exposes archived suppression footage, deletion artefacts and cracked image layers beneath. Text: HONOR PROPHETS as official tribute copy; TRIED TO KILL interrupts as a harsh system override. Red deletion artefacts bleed down the screen wall toward the floor.
Red corruption flows toward the trenches.
s08-see: Cable-vipers rise upright from network trenches like surveillance cobras; above them a city-scale sensor eye, a giant lidar iris. On "I" a stable warm shaft of light (no scanner, no housing) drops through the noise and isolates one viper, revealing every hidden cable path. Text: BROOD OF VIPERS as a threat classification; I stable and luminous; SEE opens like an iris, holy and uncorrupted.
Divine sight is superior to surveillance sight.
The warm light withdraws upward; hard cut on the downbeat.
The exposed cable paths, now a cold grid.
s09-gnat: A hyper-fine mesh filter catches a tiny glitching insect-drone; pull back: a massive approved cargo block (an oversized data container, an armoured transport block) passes through the next lane unchecked. Text: STRAIN A GNAT micro-small, forensic; LET THE CAMEL THROUGH huge and shameless, clipping through the frame.
Petty scrutiny beside giant tolerated corruption.
The cargo block rolls on to the conveyor.
s10-loads: Endless crates of devices, debt ledgers, legal packets, biometric dossiers and compliance modules on an automated conveyor; robotic arms assign them to anonymous low-level user silhouettes while executive control pods hover above, untouched. Text: HEAVY LOADS drops with weight; YOU NEVER LIFT TOO stays elevated and detached, never touching the burden.
The conveyor ends at a payment terminal.
s11-widow: A checkout/donation interface fills the frame with the film's first smiling synthetic face; a blindfold glitch band slides over its eyes while the total rises. On "widow" a small thin warm-lit silhouette places two copper coins; on "pays" they slide down a collection funnel into the black chalice's green. Text: BLIND GUIDES SMILE in pleasant UX type that slowly corrupts; WIDOW PAYS lands as a thermal-receipt burst.
Predatory systems with polished friendly UI.
s12-gate: A sleek access portal in a neon corridor: paywall prompts, biometric scans, subscription tiers, authorisation badges; it opens briefly for premium clearance, then slams behind a lattice of red laser geometry. Text: SELL THE GATE as storefront UI and price tiers; GUARD THE GATE as hard-lock access-denied overlays.
Access monetised, then protected by power.
The red laser lattice heats up.
s13-vipers2: The corridor overheats; cable-vipers slither up the gate pillars; warning lights pulse; the whole access system glows hotter, judgment moving down the circuitry. Text: BROOD OF VIPERS crawls up both frame edges; "fire?" as a thermal warning exceeding system limits.
The threat escalates: judgment moving down the circuitry.
Heat glare becomes a glass case.
s14-scrolls: Official text revered in a glass case of pristine digital tablets. On "kiss" a synthetic spokesperson face presses its lips to the glass and leaves a gold lip-print; on "tongues" it opens its mouth and a forked waveform cuts through the text, striking a red line through GOD beside the lip-print. Text: YOU KISS THE SCROLLS elegant and reverent; CALL GOD A LIAR tears through as a contradiction alert.
A contradiction glitch tears into the next shot.
s15-graves: A swarm of drone sprayers and cleanup bots coats a damaged server block, cracked transit pillar and polluted wall in glossy white and branded atmosphere; perfumed aesthetic fog rolls in; corruption pulses beneath. Text: PAINT THE GRAVES applied like glossy finish layers; INCENSE floats as vapour type; SKILL as smug presentation copy. In the last frames the camera finds the black chalice on the freshly lacquered block.
s16-see2: Cable-vipers flow over the chalice like harnesses; the same warm shaft of light as 0:49 falls from above, and where it touches, the titanium turns translucent and the green poison shows through; nearby LED faces freeze. Text: BROOD OF VIPERS as a dossier header; I warm and stable; SEE resolves where the light passes through.
He sees what the polish cannot hide.
The x-rayed chalice gives way to black visors.
s17-we-see: A line of glossy smart visors, AR headsets and black mirrored screens in darkness; reflected city lights die one by one until the visor wall is black; faint crowd silhouettes behind are guided by dead navigation arrows. Text: WE SEE as smug slogan copy; DARKNESS STAYS swallows the frame in signal blackout.
The visor wall goes to true black and holds 12 frames.
Blackout, then the white clean room.
s18-clean: A sterile white clean-room interface: robotic arms, sensor poles and compliance scanners around the chalice in purified water; as the system declares itself clean, contamination blooms through the water and fingerprints, transaction trails and command prompts overlay the scene. Text: WE'RE CLEAN as corporate assurance; HANDS STILL RAISE through repeated approve / confirm / authorise gesture icons. At the end the approve icons become three pale robotic hands, open and raised.
Match-dissolve from the clouding water into the silver flow.
s19-silver: Silver tokens and credits pour into the raised robotic palms and overflow; on "blood" the overflow hits the white floor and turns red, spreading through the puddles. Text: SILVER IN YOUR PALMS metallic and seductive; BLOOD ON THE FLOOR smears across the reflection.
No cut: the red spill leads the camera in one push to the doorway.
Red spill runs to a luminous doorway.
s20-door: A luminous doorway into a warm protected chamber; in front, turnstiles, algorithmic barriers, status tiers, denial prompts and a hard-lock scan gate; beyond glass, anonymous silhouettes wait with tin cups, low-battery devices and faded IDs. Text: YOU STAND IN THE DOOR vertical threshold text; WON'T WALK IN hard-freezes; OR LET THE POOR obstructed by denial overlays and barrier graphics.
The doorway's warm light becomes fire.
s21-vipers3: The whole city-system in judgment: server monoliths, access gates, face screens and conduits lit from below by heat and rising flame; three massive cable-vipers silhouetted against the glow. Text: the hook huge, near-monumental, but digital and glitch-tech.
Chorus climax: the whole system in judgment.
Enters as the film's one smash cut into fire; hard cut out on the downbeat.
The burning towers become failing dashboards.
s22-fall: A control room of stacked dashboards, projection maps, campaign screens and predictive models fails: towers of UI windows collapse, charts shatter, slogans dim, and a central core light warms for the first time. Text: TURN YOUR HEARTS gentler, calmer; PROUD DREAMS as polished campaign copy that loses structural integrity.
The invitation to repent; false ambition falls.
A slow 1.5 s dissolve into the quiet reed: the film's only soft transition.
The core light warms the debris.
s23-reed: After the collapse, quiet: in a dim warm pocket among the debris, a fragile signal filament (a thin green reed-like cable, a cracked antenna) still glows faintly. It is not destroyed; nothing attacks. Text: A CRACKED REED BRUISED delicate, almost whispered; I WILL NEVER CRUSH OR KILL stable and compassionate, no glitch.
Mercy: tenderness in contrast to everything else.
The reed's glow, then rigid vipers.
s24-bend: The cable-vipers rigid and upright, wrapped round control pylons, access rails and payout columns; synthetic faces nearby freeze in defiance. Text: BROOD OF VIPERS classified and severe; IF YOU WON'T BEND stretches across frame like a stress test that never yields.
The pylons the vipers grip, still whole.
s25-stones: Open on the pylons the rigid vipers grip; on "stones" white-hot light cracks through them under the coils, the vipers in hard silhouette, still unbent; widen as walls, housings, floor slabs and dead screens light from within and carry the words. Text: THE STONES WILL SPEAK MY WILL distributed across the architecture; MY the one stable gold-white word.
The system itself testifies: the stones speak.
s26-clean-cup: 2:30–2:34 the light from the stones gathers into one warm-gold point that sinks into the chalice; 2:34–2:40 the green burns off from the bottom up and the reflected faces and racks go dark; the old scanline tries to crawl over the cup, finds nothing to grip, and fades; 2:40–2:44 the empty cup lit from inside, camera still; captions "First clean the inside of the cup" (2:40.5) and MATTHEW 23:26 (2:43); hold, then fade to black over the last 1.5 s.
Resolves inside/outside: the cup made clean from within.
